title: Frontier Autolab: Organizational Memory, Adversarial Dissent and Temporal Leakage in Multi-Agent LLM Firms Across Fifty Years of Technological Change
abstract: arXiv:2609.36739v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems are increasingly structured like organizations, with roles, critics and shared memory, yet they are evaluated on tasks that last minutes. We ask how such an organization behaves when the ground it stands on keeps moving. Frontier Autolab is a long-horizon testbed in which one simulated firm, voiced by sixteen role personas and a dedicated Red Team, must re-found itself in nine technology eras from 1990 to 2040. Each era is temporally gated: the firm decides from a dated briefing, a historian-judge then reveals what happened and scores the decision on a five-dimension rubric, and lessons enter a persistent Playbook. Six eras are scored against history, one against the live market and two are open forecasts. Across four trajectories (36 era decisions, 180 subscores) we find a consistent foresight-commitment gap: in all 24 historically scored eras the judge rated the firm's recognition of the coming shift above its

translated_title: 前沿自动实验室：跨越五十年技术变革的多智能体LLM企业中的组织记忆、对抗性异议与时间泄露
translated_abstract: 多智能体LLM系统正日益被构建得如同组织一般，拥有角色分工、批评者和共享记忆，但它们通常只在持续几分钟的任务上接受评估。我们提出的问题是：当这些组织脚下的地基不断变动时，它们会如何表现。Frontier Autolab（前沿自动实验室）是一个长时程测试平台，其中一家由十六个角色人设和一个专职红队共同发声的模拟企业，必须在从1990年到2040年的九个技术时代中不断“重建”自身。每个时代在时间上是封闭推进的：企业根据一份带有日期的简报做出决策，随后由一位历史学家裁判揭示实际发生了什么，并依据五维度评分标准为该决策打分，经验教训则进入一个持久的“行动剧本”中。六个时代依据真实历史评分，一个依据实时市场评分，两个为开放式预测。在四条轨迹（36次时代决策、180项子评分）中，我们发现了一个一致的“预见-承诺差距”：在全部24个按历史评分的时代中，裁判对企业识别即将到来的变革之能力的评价高于其对……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出长时程测试平台Frontier Autolab，让由十六个角色人设和红队构成的多智能体LLM模拟企业在1990–2040年的九个技术时代中反复自我重建，并在所有24个历史评分时代中发现了一致的“预见强于承诺”差距。
en_tdlr: We introduce Frontier Autolab, a long-horizon testbed where a sixteen-persona multi-agent LLM firm with a dedicated Red Team must re-found itself across nine technology eras (1990–2040), revealing a consistent foresight-commitment gap in all 24 historically scored eras.
